design_philosophy: A highly professional, trustworthy, and modern electrical services landing page. We use a dominant dark blue (#0F172A) to project authority and security, contrasted sharply with electric yellow (#FACC15) for high-conversion CTAs. The layout balances structural rigidity (bento grids, clean lines) with generous padding to create a premium corporate feel. Forms and interactive elements use subtle tactile depth.

typography.h1: text-4xl md:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tight leading-none text-white

spacing_and_layout.grid_bento: grid grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-2 lg:grid-cols-4 gap-6 md:gap-8

interactive_states.primary_button: bg-[#FACC15] text-[#0F172A] hover:bg-[#EAB308] transition-colors font-bold shadow-lg hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-0.5
interactive_states.secondary_button: bg-transparent border-2 border-white text-white hover:bg-white hover:text-[#0F172A] transition-colors font-bold
interactive_states.card_hover: hover:shadow-xl hover:-translate-y-1 transition-all duration-300 border border-slate-200 hover:border-[#FACC15]

sections.name: Navigation
sections.style: fixed w-full z-50 bg-[#0F172A]/95 backdrop-blur-md border-b border-white/10
sections.elements: Logo (Text + Lightning Icon in Yellow), Nav Links (White), CTA Button (Yellow)

sections.name: Hero
sections.style: relative min-h-[90vh] flex items-center bg-[#0F172A] overflow-hidden
sections.overlay: absolute inset-0 bg-gradient-to-r from-[#0F172A] via-[#0F172A]/80 to-[#0F172A]/40
sections.elements: Left-aligned content. H1 'Soluciones Eléctricas en Buenos Aires'. Trust Subtitle. Two CTAs (Solicitar Presupuesto, Llamar Ahora). Trust badges row below CTAs.

sections.name: Trust & Reputation Banner
sections.style: bg-white py-8 border-b border-slate-200 shadow-sm relative -mt-8 mx-6 md:mx-auto max-w-5xl rounded-xl z-10
sections.elements: Flex row displaying '5.0 Rating', '36 Opiniones en Google', 'Atención 24/7', 'Garantía Escrita'.

sections.name: About Us
sections.elements: Split grid (1:1). Left: Structural stats (Bento style cells for '15+ Años de Experiencia', 'Cientos de obras'). Right: Narrative text on professionalism and local expertise.

sections.name: Services
sections.elements: 8 Cards. Grid: lg:grid-cols-4. Each card has an Icon (Lucide), Title, short desc. Style: Top border accent (border-t-4 border-[#FACC15]), white bg, crisp shadow.

sections.name: Testimonials
sections.elements: 3 column grid of review cards. Dark cards (bg-white/5 border border-white/10) with 5 yellow stars, client photo, and quote.

sections.name: Contact & Quote Section
sections.elements: 2 columns. Left: Direct contact info (Phone, Address, Schedule, WhatsApp link) overlaid on a map or Buenos Aires aesthetic photo. Right: Quote Request Form (Shadcn components - Inputs, Select for service type, Textarea).

sections.name: Footer
sections.elements: Logo, Quick links, Service areas, Legal.

components_to_use: lucide-react (Icons: Zap, ShieldCheck, MapPin, Phone, Clock, Star, Wrench, Lightbulb, Home, Activity, CheckCircle2)
Shadcn UI: Button, Input, Textarea, Select, Label, Form
specific_instructions: DO NOT use a fully transparent navigation bar over the hero image; use a solid or highly blurred dark background so text remains legible. Ensure all interactive elements include 'data-testid' attributes (e.g., data-testid='quote-submit-button'). Implement a floating WhatsApp CTA button fixed at the bottom right using the green color (#25D366) and high z-index.
